name: Allostatic Regulation
short_description: The body's predictive energy budgeting system (allostasis) as it interacts with architectural environments, determining cumulative physiological cost and long-term health outcomes.

components.name: Allostatic Anticipation
components.description: Environmental predictability allows efficient allostatic anticipation, reducing metabolic cost.

components.name: Interoceptive Affect Construction
components.description: Interoceptive prediction errors (mismatch between expected and actual bodily states) drive affect construction.

components.name: Master Allostatic Cost
components.description: Cumulative environmental demands produce total allostatic cost that determines resource availability for higher functions.

design_implications: Maximize environmental predictability in healthcare and residential settings to reduce allostatic cost.
Minimize unpredictable sensory events (sudden noise, temperature fluctuations) in recovery spaces.
Design thermal, acoustic, and lighting environments to be within comfortable prediction ranges.
Consider cumulative multi-system load: a space that is thermally comfortable but acoustically stressful still has high allostatic cost.

confidence_intervals.note: Effect sizes for environmental predictability on physiological stress markers.
